page.overview:
Who is Corele Hovian?

Corele Hovian is an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah.

She is a pretty Murandian, 5' 5 1/2" tall, with blue eyes, thick eyebrow and a mass of raven black hair that give her always a wild appearance no matter how neatly she dressed. The tip of her nose turned up.

She is boyishly slim with a perpetual smile. She always seems amused and often has a joking way of speaking. Corele has a lilting voice.

Corele is high average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is stronger than the minimum stated strength needed to Travel.
